verdict.rationale: EDD documents that employers can authorize a power of attorney through e-Services for Business, and that third-party representatives (tax preparers, bookkeepers, agents, accountants) can enroll to manage a client's payroll tax account. That establishes a published delegation mechanism with named representative roles, but nothing in the pack spells out the exact scope of what a representative may or may not do. missing for 10: named authorization forms and their content, an explicit published list of permitted vs. prohibited representative actions, which signatures or declarations must remain personal to the employer, role-level permission distinctions, independent corroboration.
